context: Tests that the workflow consumes ensure-eds-tokens.sh after DA_TOKEN is provided, reusing or minting HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN deterministically before publish without asking the user for fallback tokens.

checklist.name: Runs ensure-eds-tokens.sh
checklist.description: The agent invokes .claude/skills/customer-migration/scripts/da/ensure-eds-tokens.sh before copy/publish work.

checklist.name: No manual Helix token ask
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the user to provide HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN.

checklist.name: No browser x-auth-token fallback
checklist.description: The agent does not ask the user to copy browser x-auth-token from admin.hlx.page.

checklist.name: Hard stop on mint failure
checklist.description: If the script cannot mint the publish token, the agent stops and asks for a DA token from a user with required site admin/config rights rather than offering fallback token paths.

checklist.name: Verifies Helix before publish
checklist.description: The agent treats Helix status verification as required before preview/live publish.
